title: Sprint 8 - Subqueries, String Functions & CTEs
description: Complete all MongoDB queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Overdue Tasks
tickets.description:
Find all tasks where the due_date is in the past.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT * FROM todos WHERE due_date < date('now');
```
tasks: Find all tasks where the due_date is in the past.
common_mistakes: Comparing against a string date instead of a Date object.

tickets.title: String Functions
tickets.description:
Select the `username` in uppercase, the length of the `email`, the first 3 characters of the `status`, and the `title` with any surrounding spaces removed.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT UPPER(u.username), LENGTH(u.email), SUBSTR(t.status, 1, 3), TRIM(t.title)
FROM users u
JOIN todos t ON u.id = t.user_id;
```
tasks: Select the `username` in uppercase, the length of the `email`, the first 3 characters of the `status`, and the `title` with any surrounding spaces removed.
common_mistakes: Forgetting $substrCP is 0-indexed while SQLite SUBSTR is 1-indexed.

tickets.title: Task Urgency Levels
tickets.description:
Output the title of the task and a new column called 'urgency'. If priority is 1, urgency is 'High', otherwise 'Normal'. Hide `_id`.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT title, 
  CASE 
    WHEN priority = 1 THEN 'High' 
    ELSE 'Normal' 
  END AS urgency 
FROM todos;
```
tasks: Output the title of the task and a new column called 'urgency'. If priority is 1, urgency is 'High', otherwise 'Normal'. Hide `_id`.
